##### Project general facts

Bluewaters Bay is a premium waterfront residential development located at the entrance of Bluewaters Island, offering a collection of contemporary apartments with panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf, Bluewaters, and the JBR skyline. Designed around the connection between land and sea, the development features open-plan layouts, expansive terraces, and floor-to-ceiling glazing that create bright and spacious living environments. Inspired by the relaxed elegance of Miami living, Bluewaters Bay combines sophisticated architecture with a sense of calm and sanctuary.

The development offers a lifestyle designed around relaxation, wellness, and connection with the surrounding environment. Residents can enjoy beautifully designed outdoor spaces, serene pathways, and open areas overlooking the sea and vibrant cityscape. The carefully planned setting creates a balance between tranquil waterfront living and the energy of Dubai, providing spaces ideal for relaxation and spending time with family and friends.

The residences feature contemporary interiors with carefully curated finishes and modern design details. Floor-to-ceiling glass allows natural light to flood the living spaces, while expansive terraces extend the interiors towards the surrounding seaside views. Modern open-plan kitchens, spacious bedrooms, and upgraded bathroom finishes create a refined and comfortable living environment. The kitchens feature superior layouts and finishes, while the apartments are luxury furnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Bluewaters Island is a prestigious waterfront destination in Dubai, located just off the coast of Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR) and adjacent to Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah. The island combines contemporary residential living with a vibrant mix of hospitality, dining, retail, leisure, and entertainment, creating an exclusive lifestyle destination surrounded by the Arabian Gulf.

The area is home to Ain Dubai, the world’s tallest observation wheel, which has become one of Dubai’s most recognisable landmarks. Bluewaters also features a wide selection of restaurants, cafés, retail concepts, hotels, and leisure attractions, making everyday entertainment and dining easily accessible to residents.

With its waterfront setting and proximity to JBR and Dubai Marina, Bluewaters Island offers a combination of peaceful island living and convenient access to the city’s major lifestyle destinations. The island is connected to the mainland and benefits from its position along Dubai’s vibrant coastline, with panoramic views of the sea, Dubai Marina skyline, and surrounding landmarks.
